headline: New era for Free School Meals in England
meta_description: England enters a new chapter for free school meal provision, bringing change to how students access nutrition during the school day.
summary_short: England is entering a new era for free school meals, marking a significant shift in how the country supports student nutrition and wellbeing.
body:
England is entering a new era for free school meals, marking a significant shift in how the country supports student nutrition and wellbeing.

The development signals renewed commitment to ensuring that young people across England have access to meals during the school day. This change reflects broader recognition of the connection between nutrition and academic success, as well as the role schools play in supporting families.

The initiative comes as communities continue to discuss how best to support children's health and development. The new approach to free school meal provision promises to shape how schools, families, and policymakers work together on this essential service.
quick_facts: England entering new era for free school meal provision
Policy change affects student nutrition and wellbeing
Reflects commitment to supporting children across England
